new_app_semantics: Set only file birth time to the resolved instant.
constraints: Preserve modification time or require previewed volume normalization.

new_app_semantics: Set only modification time and verify actual volume precision.
constraints: Retain birth time unless a previewed filesystem constraint requires normalization.

reference_action: Set file creation and modification dates
new_app_semantics: Set birth and modification times to the chosen resolved instant.
constraints: Read back both; reject an unrepresentable date.

new_app_semantics: Set explicitly selected qualified photo/video capture timestamp tags.
constraints: Group-specific write capability and payload integrity must pass.

new_app_semantics: Support every inspected advanced source, target selection, shift and sequencing.
constraints: Missing Spotlight data and ambiguous reference matches are unavailable, not guessed.

reference_action: Copy file modification date to file creation date
new_app_semantics: Copy original modification time to birth time.
constraints: Use previewed original source value; preserve unselected fields.

reference_action: Copy file creation date to file modification date
new_app_semantics: Copy original birth time to modification time.
constraints: Do not read a previously mutated value as the source.

reference_action: Copy EXIF content creation timestamp to file creation date
new_app_semantics: Resolve a capture candidate and set file birth time.
constraints: Missing offset requires visible timezone selection.

reference_action: Copy file creation date to EXIF content creation timestamp
new_app_semantics: Write original file birth time to selected embedded capture fields.
constraints: Use explicit timezone/offset and qualified writable tag destinations.

new_app_semantics: Shift file birth time by an explicit signed seconds duration.
constraints: Days mean 86400 seconds; companion-field normalization must be previewed.

new_app_semantics: Shift modification time by a signed duration.
constraints: Preserve source date precision to destination capability.

reference_action: Adjust file creation and file modification dates
new_app_semantics: Shift original birth and modification instants by the same duration.
constraints: Apply both final attributes after embedded writes.

new_app_semantics: Shift selected embedded capture timestamp families.
constraints: Preserve explicit offsets and record reduced precision.

reference_action: Adjust file creation and EXIF content creation timestamp
new_app_semantics: Shift original birth and selected embedded capture timestamps together.
constraints: Journal the whole selected operation; no silent partial success.

new_app_semantics: Expose Reset creation date with value 1904-01-01T00:00:00Z.
constraints: Do not claim a mandatory filesystem date becomes absent; unsupported volume blocks.

reference_action: Remove file creation and modification date
new_app_semantics: Reset birth and modification dates to 1904-01-01T00:00:00Z.
constraints: Require representation of both on the target volume.

new_app_semantics: Delete only selected supported embedded shooting-date fields.
constraints: Do not erase unrelated dates; verify expected fields absent.

new_app_semantics: Edit typed writable descriptive fields including lists and language alternatives.
constraints: No raw switches, code, read-only tags or unsupported write profile.

reference_action: Remove EXIF/ IPTC/ GPS metadata tag(s)
new_app_semantics: Remove the exact selected writable EXIF/IPTC/GPS fields.
constraints: Retain nonselected tag values, rendering data and payloads.

new_app_semantics: Remove supported GPS and named-location fields across recognized groups.
constraints: Recognized residual embedded GPS yields incomplete-removal status.

new_app_semantics: Strip supported descriptive metadata while preserving listed rendering/link data.
constraints: Disable blanket stripping of RAW/unverified HEIF/video profiles and explain exclusions.

reference_action: Change the visibility of the file extension
new_app_semantics: Change the selected extension-hidden flag.
constraints: Preserve filename, content and unrelated FinderInfo fields.

new_app_semantics: Set or clear only the selected file lock flag.
constraints: Unlock before another write only when explicitly previewed; do not alter ACL/mode.

new_app_semantics: Change the selected Finder label bits.
constraints: Preserve unrelated FinderInfo and user tag information.

reference_action: Set the legacy file creator and type codes
new_app_semantics: Set two four-byte legacy codes.
constraints: Validate exact byte counts and preserve every unrelated FinderInfo byte.

reference_action: Set the legacy file creator code
new_app_semantics: Set only the four-byte legacy creator code.
constraints: Retain legacy type and every unrelated attribute.

reference_action: Set the legacy file type code
new_app_semantics: Set only the four-byte legacy type code.
constraints: Retain legacy creator and every unrelated attribute.

new_app_semantics: Zero only the selected creator/type field or both.
constraints: Preserve remaining FinderInfo bytes.

new_app_semantics: Preview exact scoped hidden regular files and send selected files to system Trash.
constraints: Separate terminal workflow; no permanent deletion, package recursion or symlink following.

new_app_semantics: Remove only com.apple.metadata:kMDItemWhereFroms.
constraints: Preserve quarantine and all other xattrs.

reference_action: Force the Finder to update its information on the file(s)
new_app_semantics: Notify Finder of selected changed URLs.
constraints: No Finder restart or global preference mutation.
